name: Barista Coach
summary: Espresso dial-in guidance through the glasses

actions.name: dial_in_shot
actions.description: Use when the user wants help dialing in espresso — shot ran too fast or slow, tastes sour or bitter, or they mention grind size, dose, or yield.

shot_time_s.description: How long the shot ran, in seconds

taste.description: How it tasted: sour, bitter, balanced, weak

binding.template: The user is dialing in espresso on a {{setting.roast_level}} roast. Shot time: {{shot_time_s}}s, taste: {{taste}}. Target 25-30s for a 1:2 ratio. Sour or fast means grind finer or dose up slightly; bitter or slow means grind coarser or dose down. Give ONE specific adjustment to try next, sized to how far off they are, then stop.

actions.name: brew_ratio
actions.description: Use when the user asks what yield or ratio to target for an espresso dose, e.g. 'I dosed 18 grams, what should I pull?'

binding.template: Dose is {{dose_g}}g on a {{setting.roast_level}} roast. Recommend a target yield in grams for a 1:2 ratio (1:2.5 if the roast is light), state the number plainly, and mention the 25-30s window.
